banner.help: Drag a user from the left list onto an empty area to add them to the team, or drop them on a card to add them as that person’s report. Draw an arrow from the bottom dot of a card to the top dot of another to set reports-to. Click a card or arrow then press Delete to remove it. Click the pencil on a card to give them a position label (e.g. “Sales Head”).
